observations.result: State, contracts, architecture and distribution checks pass; 76 tests with 410 expectations pass; main/preload/renderer bundles compile at 119.42 KB, 4.77 KB and 91.1 KB; Knip is clean; report-only Fallow health is 87.9/A with only the pre-existing scripts/status.ts collectRow advisory.
The provider and model-lifecycle increment is clean with no dead-code, complexity or duplication findings.
No unused files, dependencies, exports or other Knip findings reported.

16 focused tests with 88 expectations pass for provider selection, endpoint and credential validation, scope denial, no-fallback behavior, timeout, cancellation, quota, redacted errors, model integrity/version/offline states, reindexing, derivative deletion and portable conversation export.
Main, preload and renderer bundles compile with provider settings/status IPC and the visible credential-storage controls.
Compiled bundles contain no fixture credential values or embedded proxy secret; provider credentials are accepted only by the main-process OS-backed safeStorage seam.

implemented: Added shared managed/BYOK/local provider settings, endpoint validation, model selection, credential references, usage caps, availability states and explicit fallback none status.

Added a main/preload provider settings and credential IPC seam; Electron safeStorage encrypts credential values before writing an OS-protected metadata file, while the renderer clears the entered secret after storage.

Added an injected provider transport contract with selected-scope and exclusion checks, transient credential handoff, timeout/cancellation aborts, redacted transport errors, hard usage accounting and no implicit fallback.
Added local model integrity manifests, version/offline readiness inspection, reindex decisions, derivative deletion planning that preserves source notes and portable conversation export.
Added deterministic provider/model fixtures and API/provider regression tests; MCP/CLI adapters and managed operations/billing remain explicit future handoffs with no paid provisioning.
limitations: No live managed OpenRouter proxy, BYOK endpoint or local model runtime was contacted; connectivity, retention, billing, hardware capability and performance claims remain external-pending.
The provider transport is an injected typed seam rather than a live HTTP adapter, and provider-backed free-form AI drafting is not yet wired into the reviewed-change broker.
The local Electron binary is unavailable, so visible provider settings, accessibility-tree behavior, cross-platform runs and reference-Obsidian round trips remain external-pending.
